| description = Holder of the elusive and legendary T-staff. T-Staff is shown when he has it but beware, a Warlord with a staff can hit significantly harder than one without. Three spawn locations possible - rooms in back of Left Courtyard, Jail rooms, and finally as one of two mobs at end of entry hall between the two courtyards (just past bridge 2). Skeletal Warlord and placeholders (Skeletal Guardian and Drolvarg Sentry) have 27min respawn timers. The Drolvarg Sentry placeholder does not give faction hits to Venril Sathir faction. Only one Skeletal Warlord can be up in KC at a time and thus tracking is useful for this camp. The staff is very rare and anyone farming it can expect to spend hundreds of hours before they ever see a staff. Legends say some who tried went mad or even died and found home in the moat that surrounds the castle.
